nodes.name: gdt.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the GlobalDescriptorTable and its nested SegmentDescriptor class. The GDT constructor loads the GDT register via the lgdt instruction. SegmentDescriptor encodes 32-bit base and limit into a compact 8-byte descriptor format with 20-bit limit and 32-bit base fields.
nodes.languageNotes: uses inline assembly (lgdt); manual bit-field encoding of segment descriptors

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable
nodes.summary: Manages the x86 GDT with null, unused, code (0x9A) and data (0x92) segment selectors. Provides CodeSegmentSelector and DataSegmentSelector methods returning offset-based segment selectors.
nodes.languageNotes: packed SegmentDescriptor nested class; uses placement in memory to compute selectors

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable::GlobalDescriptorTable
nodes.summary: Constructor. Initializes null, unused, code (0x9A, 64MB), and data (0x92, 64MB) segment descriptors, then loads the GDT via lgdt instruction.
nodes.languageNotes: uses inline assembly; computes GDT pointer from this pointer

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable::~GlobalDescriptorTable
nodes.summary: Destructor.

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable::DataSegmentSelector
nodes.summary: Returns the data segment selector value (offset of dataSegmentSelector from this).

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable::CodeSegmentSelector
nodes.summary: Returns the code segment selector value (offset of codeSegmentSelector from this).

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable::SegmentDescriptor::SegmentDescriptor
nodes.summary: Constructs a segment descriptor encoding 32-bit base and limit into an 8-byte packed structure. Handles 16-bit vs 32-bit addressing and limit granularity.
nodes.languageNotes: manual bit-field encoding; limit granularity adjustment

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable::SegmentDescriptor::Base
nodes.summary: Decodes and returns the 32-bit base address from the packed descriptor.

nodes.name: GlobalDescriptorTable::SegmentDescriptor::Limit
nodes.summary: Decodes and returns the 32-bit limit from the packed descriptor, applying 4KB page granularity when 32-bit mode is set.

nodes.name: gdt.h
nodes.summary: Declares the GlobalDescriptorTable class with a packed nested SegmentDescriptor class. The GDT holds null, unused, code (executable/readable), and data (read/write) segment selectors.
nodes.languageNotes: uses common/types.h typedefs; packed attribute on SegmentDescriptor

nodes.name: SegmentDescriptor
nodes.summary: Packed 8-byte x86 segment descriptor encoding base (32-bit) and limit (20-bit) with type flags.

nodes.name: multitasking.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements cooperative multitasking: Task constructor initializes a CPU state on a 4KB stack for a given entry point, and TaskManager schedules tasks via round-robin.
nodes.languageNotes: CPUState is packed struct; round-robin scheduling

nodes.name: Task::Task
nodes.summary: Constructor. Sets up a CPUState on the task's 4KB stack with zeroed registers, the entry point as EIP, the GDT code segment selector, and EFLAGS (0x202).
nodes.languageNotes: CPUState placed at top of stack; GDT code selector for CS

nodes.name: Task::~Task
nodes.summary: Destructor.

nodes.name: TaskManager::TaskManager
nodes.summary: Constructor. Initializes task count to 0 and current task index to -1.

nodes.name: TaskManager::~TaskManager
nodes.summary: Destructor.

nodes.name: TaskManager::AddTask
nodes.summary: Adds a task to the scheduler. Returns false if the task table (max 256) is full.

nodes.name: TaskManager::Schedule
nodes.summary: Round-robin scheduler: saves the current CPU state, advances to the next task, and returns the new task's CPU state.
nodes.languageNotes: cooperative multitasking; called from interrupt handler

nodes.name: multitasking.h
nodes.summary: Declares CPUState (packed x86 register save area), Task (with 4KB stack and CPUState pointer), and TaskManager (round-robin scheduler with 256 task slots).

nodes.name: CPUState
nodes.summary: Packed struct representing x86 CPU register state for context switching: general purpose, segment, EIP, EFLAGS, ESP, and SS.
nodes.languageNotes: __attribute__((packed)); used by Task for context save/restore

nodes.name: Task
nodes.summary: Represents a single task with a private 4KB stack and CPUState. Initialized with a GDT and entry point function.
nodes.languageNotes: friend class TaskManager accesses private cpustate

nodes.name: TaskManager
nodes.summary: Manages up to 256 tasks with round-robin scheduling. Provides AddTask and Schedule methods for cooperative multitasking.

nodes.name: syscalls.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements SyscallHandler, a simple syscall dispatcher that handles interrupt-based system calls. Currently supports syscall number 4 (write/print) using EBX as the string pointer.
nodes.languageNotes: interrupt-based syscall dispatch; uses printf extern

nodes.name: SyscallHandler::SyscallHandler
nodes.summary: Constructor. Registers the handler with InterruptManager at the given interrupt number offset by the hardware interrupt base.

nodes.name: SyscallHandler::~SyscallHandler
nodes.summary: Destructor.

nodes.name: SyscallHandler::HandleInterrupt
nodes.summary: Dispatches syscalls based on EAX register. Supports syscall 4 (print string from EBX). Returns the updated ESP.

nodes.name: syscalls.h
nodes.summary: Declares SyscallHandler extending InterruptHandler, dispatching system calls from user-space via interrupts.

nodes.name: SyscallHandler
nodes.summary: Interrupt handler subclass that dispatches system calls. Receives an interrupt manager and interrupt number, provides HandleInterrupt override.
